title: .respawnpack/runtime/contract.json — the goal-mode runtime contract
description: Written by scripts/goal-contract.mjs (activate / close / bump). Gitignored and machine-local by design: autonomy must never travel in a clone. Distinct from runtime-contract.schema.json (the interaction contract: mode/task/acceptance). This schema covers the GOAL-mode runtime pointer: which goal is active, the current atomic task, cycle count, last progress/checkpoint timestamps, handoff history, session append log. Schema-only validation; the procedural loader in scripts/goal-contract.mjs is the production validator.

schemaVersion.description: Must match scripts/goal-contract.mjs#CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION (1.0.0). Future schema changes bump this and add a load-bearing-keyword version check to the parser.

mode.description: Always 'goal' for contracts written by this schema. runtime-contract.schema.json covers the outer interaction contract (collaborate/delegate/goal flag).

activeGoalId.description: Active goal ID matching /^G-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/, or null after closeGoal(). A non-null value drives the rollover bridge's goal-mode threshold ladder; null means goal-mode is suspended/closed.

goal.description: The goal's prose text (a copy of the durable docs/goal.md `goal:` field at activation time). Empty-string enforcement is done by the procedural validator (validateGoal/activateGoal); the schema only constrains the type. (validate.mjs's supported-keyword set does not include minLength, so the constraint that would catch an empty string here would have to be a `pattern` or `enum` — both worse than letting the procedure enforce it.)

currentAtomicTask.description: The current cold-startable atomic task the operator is working on. null when the goal has no unmet completion item.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the contract was first created. Preserved across same-goal re-activations; reset only on a different-goal activation.

cycleCount.description: Number of times the session has bumped against this contract. Reset only when activeGoalId changes to a different goalId; preserved on same-goal re-activation and on close → activate.

lastProgressAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent bumpCycleCount() call. Stamped by stop-savepoint when the session ends in goal mode (per D6/C, distinct from lastCheckpointAt which is stamped by the rollover extension's closeout path).

lastCheckpointAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent rollover-extension closeout in goal mode. null until the first closeout fires (per D6/C, distinct from lastProgressAt which is bumped by stop-savepoint).

handoffs.description: Append-only list of handoff records (handoff-id + path) consumed by the next session. Currently unused by the writer (kept as a future hook point); declared so the schema pin holds the field.

sessions.description: Append-only log of session ids that have bumped the cycle count. Capped at last 32 by bumpCycleCount(). May be absent when the contract is fresh (initRuntimeContract does not seed it).

closedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of closeGoal(). Only present after close; absent on a contract that has never been closed (since a re-activate preserves the prior sessions[] but resets activeGoalId, this field is purely a closing record).
